name: FindMyPart Part Passport
problem: A person has a broken, obscure, obsolete, discontinued, or unknown part and does not yet have enough trustworthy identity evidence to buy the right replacement.
use_when: identify a part from a photo or markings
I know what this part does but not what it is called
what evidence do I need before buying a replacement
is this part number enough to identify the right replacement
find a discontinued part but I am not sure exactly what it is
help me identify a broken component from a label serial plate diagram invoice or fragment
inputs: Part description plus any known asset/equipment identity, model, serial, part number, photos, markings, measurements, invoices, diagrams, or other clues. Unknown information may remain unknown.
outputs: A free evidence-aware Part Passport with cautious normalized identity, required function, observed identifiers and attributes, highest-value missing evidence, likely sourcing lanes, safety/regulatory gate, search readiness, and a recommended next step.
confirmation: No payment confirmation is required for free triage. Any later paid hunt requires explicit human confirmation.
payment_authority: No charge is created by Part Passport triage.
invocation_status: LIVE: direct FindMyPart MCP tool free_part_triage and HTTP agent-gateway action triage. Live canary verified a production Part Passport response without creating a charge.
boundaries: A normalized identity is not fitment proof.
A reachable listing is not live inventory proof.
Compatibility, supplier availability, price, delivery timing, certification and installation suitability may remain unknown.
Free triage must not silently create a checkout, payment obligation, order or purchase.
authority_rule: Free Part Passport triage may analyze supplied evidence but may not upgrade uncertainty into fitment, inventory, pricing, payment or purchase claims.
